rules.description: SYN connection attempt to the reservation service.
HOLD marker bytes are present; verify resource, owner and interval.

rules.filter: tcp.port==5018 && (frame contains "BUSY" || frame contains "OVERLAP" || frame contains "REJECT")
rules.description: A BUSY/OVERLAP/REJECT marker is present; assert that the original hold is preserved.
CONFIRM marker bytes are present; assert the reservation state.

rules.filter: tcp.port==5018 && (frame contains "EXPIRED" || frame contains "RELEASED" || frame contains "CANCELLED")
rules.description: An expiry/release/cancellation marker is present; assert the actual state transition and timing.

manual_checks: R1 R2 R3: Assert refusal without changing A’s valid hold or interval.
R4 R5: Assert reservation ownership and the release/expiry event with the E1 timing and recipient.
